ablation.name: phase4e_db2_lvl1
ablation.notes: Phase 4E.1: Daubechies-2 (db2) 4-tap smooth orthonormal wavelet, single level. Isolates the basis effect at lvl1 vs Phase 3 baseline (haar lvl1, clip=0.7261). db2 has 2 vanishing moments + overlapping 4-tap support -> eliminates Haar's 2x2 checkerboard artifacts in fiber after AdaIN. Smoke test confirms db2 fiber TV is 34.5% lower than Haar after AdaIN. Only changes inference lp() path; training forward() untouched (zero parameter increase).
